text:
Amy: Kickoff — AcmeHealth POC. Need to align success criteria, eval prompts, timeline, and deployment constraints (PHI). Quick agenda: use cases -> eval set -> model/context -> tool-calling needs -> embeddings/rerank -> pricing/security blockers. Who's available for a 30m tomorrow? @Raj @Lina @Sam

Raj: I can do tomorrow AM. Narrowing scope would help — propose 2 flows: 1) Clinical note summarization (long docs) 2) Retrieval + rerank for chart search. Success targets: hallucination rate <2% on eval set, latency p50 <300ms for short queries, throughput goal 15 qps for search. Prefer private/VPC for PHI.

Lina: +1 on VPC/BYOK. Security asks: HIPAA BA + SOC2 Type II required. I've started the security questionnaire; sharing link in drive in a sec. Need clarity on data at rest: can customer keep notes in their DB and we only exchange tokens? Also need retention policy for logs.

Sam: Model thoughts: long clinical notes push us to 32k context; recommend testing redwood-1.2-32k (and an 8k variant as baseline). Tool calling: customer needs EHR lookup (patient meds/vitals) — we must support secure tool calls to internal APIs. We have a verified tool-call flow for redwood-1.2 that preserves KV cache and auth headers. For search, use embeddings -> approximate nearest neighbors -> rerank with a light LM reranker (embedding+rerank combo reduces latency and improves MRR).

Amy: Pricing question from Acme: they'd like a month trial on reserved capacity. They estimate ~100k generation tokens/day + 10k embedding calls/day. Can Finance give a ballpark?

Finance Bot: Ballpark (hosted): generation ~ $0.12 per 1k tokens -> ~$12/day for 100k tokens; embeddings ~ $0.008 per embed -> ~$80/day for 10k. Reserved/dedicated reduces per-token but needs minimum commit. I'll follow up with a 30-day estimate sheet.

Raj: For acceptance testing, propose concrete evals: (a) 500 annotated clinical notes for hallucination/factuality; (b) 1k query benchmark for retrieval + rerank measuring MRR and p95 latency; (c) integration smoke tests for toolcalls with auth. Pass criteria: hallucination <2%, MRR >= 0.82, rerank p95 latency <600ms.

Lina: Data handling: all PHI sent to Redwood Private must be encrypted with customer keys (BYOK). No logs retained beyond 30 days unless enabled. Also need an allowlist for outbound endpoints for tool calls. Can you confirm toolcall network model?

Sam: Toolcall network: in Private/VPC mode, tool calls can be tunneled to customer APIs over private peering or configured NAT with allowlisted IPs. We'll document the runbook. For dev/testing, use tokenized synthetic data.

Amy: Eval prompt example for summaries — please paste to repo:
```
Input: <full clinical note>
Task: Generate concise SOAP-style summary. Include: Problem list, Assessment, Plan, Medications, Allergies. Flag uncertain facts.
Metrics: ROUGE-L, Factuality-check (entity-level), hallucination rate (annotator-driven).
```

Raj: Also add an automated hallucination detector (we can run a QA model to verify claims against note). That counts toward factuality metric.

Lina: Timeline proposal: 4 weeks
- Week 0: Security review + legal + onboarding (data transfer method)
- Week 1: Data ingest + baseline 8k model runs
- Week 2: 32k experiments + embeddings pipeline
- Week 3: Toolcall integration + end-to-end tests
- Week 4: Final evals + handoff
Can we commit to that cadence?

Amy: Customer wants go/no-go at end of week 4. Are these resource owners OK? @Sam for eval infra, @Raj for integration, @Lina for security sign-off.

Sam: I can own eval infra. Need synthetic dataset by EOD Tuesday and access to 3 sample patient records (anonymized) to test 32k flow.

Raj: I'll own integration. Need API specs + auth method from Acme. Please confirm whether OAuth or mTLS.

Lina: I'll push the security questionnaire items that block demo: BYOK, retention, IP allowlist, and BA. If those are green, I'll sign off.

Amy: Action items:
- Acme: provide API spec + sample records (Amy)
- Security questionnaire link + checklist (Lina)
- Pricing/estimate (Finance Bot)
- Eval prompts + synthetic set (Sam + Raj)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept these ownerships.

Raj: :thumbsup:

Sam: :thumbsup:

Lina: :thumbsup: Will upload SQ answers by EOD today.

Amy: Great — I'll book the 30m kickoff for tomorrow 10am PT and add agenda + notes. Thanks everyone.
